item.title: MNLP - Exam Analysis
item.description: MNLP - Exam Analysis What the exam looks like Two hours on paper, multiple choice and multiple selection only, questions grouped in blocks by topic with every question independent of the others, and one two-sided cheat sheet that can be printed.

item.title: MNLP-L02 - Multilinguality and Writing Systems
item.description: MNLP-L02: Multilinguality and Writing Systems In short Standard NLP pipelines split on whitespace, rely on word order, treat a word as one unit of meaning and assume text runs left to right.

item.title: MNLP-L03 - Morphology and Word Formation
item.description: MNLP-L03: Morphology and Word Formation In short Word-level models learn meaning from context (embeddings, CBOW), but store move and moved as unrelated row numbers and have nothing for an unseen word such as hammered.

item.title: MNLP-L04 - Subword Segmentation
item.description: MNLP-L04: Subword Segmentation In short How can a model with a fixed vocabulary handle words it has never seen? Whole words turn every unseen word into <UNK>.
